provenance.status: A repeat-run CONVENIENCE, never the evidence of record. Ticket 09's evidence for AC5 is the live two-sided run quoted verbatim in its Comments; this file lets later runs compare without standing the pinned toolkit up again.

loadprogress.note: The pin throttles to one report per 80 ms and chases the raw ratio, and it emits the final 1 TWICE (the throttled report and the ready branch). Ruling Stop 5 (P1) replaced that stream with report-on-rise and exactly one 1 — doc 06 D29 item 2. Values and counts are therefore NOT compared; the sequence of event TYPES, the payload shapes, and the ready/stopchanged values are.
